body:
IDUNA commits d0a53f2, d67adac; PRRJECT_FATBABY commit 5876dce; EMILY commit 3ce5633e. Founder real-time, three follow-up messages continuing the Emily for Business thread: (1) 'so to make iduna multi tenant we need like a DB per install and we need console.okemily.com for our customers and partners to onboard also we can use the fatbaby proxies for offering custom subdomains for partners/customers'; (2) 'so we need multi tenant iduna as a platform we can offer a free trial that really stands up their iduna instance - we pull some of the more custom stuff out of iduna and the code goes right into the emily for business product IDUNA_PRO'; (3) 'so we use our IDUNA to manage the free trials for emily for business'. Real findings, each checked directly: DB-per-install is already near-free (IDUNA's own main.go resolves its DB from a single SQLITE_PATH env var per process, migrations run clean against an empty file -- the real work is orchestration, not a database redesign). console.okemily.com does not exist anywhere in the monorepo yet. The FatBaby broker (PRRJECT_FATBABY/broker) had a real, decisive gap: no Host-header/subdomain routing at all, only bearer-token and path-prefix matching -- closed directly with a new Route.Host field + Registry.ResolveByHost, checked before path-prefix in AuthMiddleware, deliberately skipping the broker's own Basic Auth since a tenant subdomain's real auth boundary is its own upstream IDUNA instance. 4 new tests, go build/vet/test ./... clean, zero regressions. okemily.com's DNS is confirmed live on Cloudflare -- a real wildcard cert needs a DNS-01 (certbot-dns-cloudflare) challenge, not the HTTP-01 flow every existing cert on this box uses, a real named decision point not resolved here. The third message resolves the doc's own original Open Question 1: internal IDUNA is not being externalized in place -- it stays the backbone and additionally becomes the control plane that provisions and tracks IDUNA_PRO tenant trials. Wrote a real, checked categorization of internal/ and http/handlers/ into core-generic IDUNA_PRO candidates (auth, store, userlog/unified-logging, the apples audit-ledger mechanism) vs genuinely monorepo-custom code that stays behind (blog, tyler, mmo/redgarden/shankpit/papercraft game handlers, vault, promptoverse, mailinglist, drive, statuspage, the BACKLOG.md-coupled kanban bridge) vs real, honestly unresolved ambiguous cases (honorcode's mechanism-vs-content split, subscriptions.go, the well-built-but-coupled kanban feature). IDUNA_PRO repo does not exist upstream yet -- checked via a real clone attempt (Repository not found) -- named only, no code moved, no repo created, matching this session's own precedent of not overreaching into unrequested execution on a genuinely large architecture decision.

⚓ ☃
title: IDUNA_PRO extraction plan + Host-based subdomain routing -- real multi-tenancy architecture direction
